label.description: Text or a 16px icon. It is the scrub handle. Icon labels need aria-label.

onValueChange.description: Fires for every change, including each scrub step. details is { source: "scrub" | "type" | "key" | "reset", unit }.

onValueCommit.description: Fires once when a change settles: a scrub ends, Enter or blur commits typing, or a key step lands.

step.description: One step for arrows and scrubbing.

coarseStep.description: Step with Shift held. Coarse steps snap to the coarse grid.

precision.description: Decimal places kept. Defaults to the precision of step or fineStep.

pixelsPerStep.description: Pointer travel in px for one step while scrubbing.

wrap.description: Wraps from max to min, as rotation does. Needs both limits.

unit.description: Controlled unit shown after the number. With more than one entry in units it becomes a button that cycles them.

defaultUnit.description: Starting unit when uncontrolled. Defaults to unit or the first of units.

units.description: Units a typed value may carry, such as ["px", "%"]. Defaults to the current unit.

onUnitChange.description: Called when a typed unit or the unit button changes the unit.

resetValue.description: Double click the label to return here.

track.description: Shows where the value sits between min and max as a quiet fill.

size.description: Field height: 30px, or the small control height.

pointerLock.description: Locks the mouse pointer while scrubbing when the browser allows it.
